title: Beyond Stereotypes: Exploring How Minority College Students Experience Stigma on Reddit
findings: Religion posts on Reddit often discuss campus religious activities and Christian institutions. Quantitative analysis revealed that posts about religion showed moderate levels of stereotyping and separation. The study's key finding is that intersecting minority statuses, particularly those involving religion, intensify the experience of stigma, leading to compounded vulnerabilities and a more severe progression of exclusion. For example, a post might discuss the struggles of an openly gay student at a conservative Christian university.

measurement_description: Detection and quantification of stigma components (labeling, stereotyping, separation, status loss, discrimination) within online discourse (Reddit posts) concerning minority college students, with religion being one of the examined minority statuses.
